The Compensation Committee of the Board is fully engaged to respond to the dynamic business environment in which we operate. As discussed in the CD&A section of this proxy statement, the Compensation Committee acts to:
• Adapt our compensation program to match the needs of our business
• Mitigate compensation-related risks to the organization
• Conduct an annual say-on-pay advisory vote and continue to engage with stockholders on executive compensation

As further discussed in the CD&A section of this proxy statement, the Compensation Committee has established the following guiding principles, policies and practices when structuring the compensation paid to our NEOs:
• Vast majority of executive pay based on performance, primarily in the form of stock-based compensation
• No executive pension plans or supplemental executive retirement plans

For a detailed discussion of our executive compensation program, and the 2025 compensation of our NEOs, see the section of this proxy statement entitled "Compensation Discussion and Analysis" beginning on page 24.
